summary.text: Lori Urso is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 8 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
She has served in the Senate since January 7, 2025, succeeding Sandra Cano, and is president and chief executive officer of the Old Slater Mill Association.

paragraphs.text: Lori Urso earned a bachelor's degree from Rutgers University and a master's degree from the University of Rhode Island.
Her career experience includes working in river and watershed conservation and serving as president and chief executive officer of the Old Slater Mill Association.
She served on the Westerly Town Council from 2000 to 2002.
Urso assumed office in the Rhode Island State Senate on January 7, 2025, and her current term ends on January 5, 2027.
